d: In this video, Firstpost explains the global Microsoft outage that disrupted Outlook and other Microsoft 365 services, including Teams. The interruption left employees and businesses across more than 70 countries struggling to access their emails and workplace tools. While the outage disrupted work routines, social media users responded with humour, sharing funny tweets about their unexpected break from office responsibilities. From jokes about being unable to work to finding creative ways to spend their downtime, the internet turned a frustrating tech disruption into a meme fest. Hem Kaur…
